build_autoencoder_rae: build an AutoencoderRAE model with a dinov2 frozen encoder and trainable ViT decoder
encode_images_to_latents: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the AutoencoderRAE encode method
decode_latents_to_images: decode latent tensors back into reconstructed images using the AutoencoderRAE decode method
run_autoencoder_forward: run a full encode-then-decode forward pass through the AutoencoderRAE model on input images
unpatchify_decoder_logits: convert patch reconstruction logits from the RAEDecoder back into pixel-space images using unpatchify
